title: Confirmed Action Ratio
scenario: Find the ratio of 'confirmed' to 'timeout' actions globally. Return the result table as 'action_ratio'.
tableSchema: signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME), confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR)
hint: Use CASE statements within a SUM to get counts for both actions.
correctQuery: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS action_ratio FROM confirmations;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR); INSERT INTO confirmations VALUES (3, '2021-01-06 03:30:46', 'timeout'), (7, '2021-06-12 11:57:29', 'confirmed');
